name: pokemon-moves-learn-method-multiplex
description: Multiplex move learnset hypergraph with PokéAPI Pokémon entries as nodes and the four main learn methods as layers: level-up, machine, egg, and tutor. In each layer, a hyperedge corresponds to one move and contains the Pokémon that can learn it by that method. Moves with the same Pokémon set in the same layer are collapsed into one hyperedge; list-valued edge metadata records all represented moves.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., pokemon-moves-learn-method-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).
hypergraph_metadata.layer_type: (STRING) Semantic type of multiplex layers (e.g., learn_method).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Pokémon name (e.g., pikachu).
nodes_metadata.generation: (STRING) Generation where the Pokémon species was introduced (e.g., generation-i).
nodes_metadata.is_default: (BOOL) Whether this is the default Pokémon form (e.g., true).
nodes_metadata.secondary_type: (STRING) Secondary Pokémon type when present (e.g., flying).

edges_metadata.move_ids: (LIST[INT]) PokéAPI move identifiers represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [85]).
edges_metadata.move_names: (LIST[STRING]) Move names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [thunderbolt]).
edges_metadata.move_types: (LIST[STRING]) Move types represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [electric]).
edges_metadata.damage_classes: (LIST[STRING]) Damage classes represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [special]).
edges_metadata.generations: (LIST[STRING]) Move introduction generations represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [generation-i]).
edges_metadata.version_groups: (LIST[STRING]) Version groups in which the incidence appears (e.g., [red-blue]).
edges_metadata.learn_methods: (STRING) Learn method represented by the multiplex layer (e.g., level-up).
edges_metadata.min_level: (LIST[INT]) Minimum nonzero levels at which a move is learned, when available (e.g., [15]).
edges_metadata.n_observations: (LIST[INT]) Numbers of raw PokéAPI learnset observations aggregated into the hyperedge (e.g., [42]).
